eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Convergence in Engineering (ICCE 2026) aims to provide a premier interdisciplinary platform for researchers, academicians, industry professionals, innovators, and students to present and discuss emerging trends, technologies, and research advancements across multiple domains of engineering. The conference focuses on the convergence of traditional engineering disciplines with modern digital technologies to address contemporary societal, industrial, and global challenges. ICCE 2026 will emphasize innovation, integration, and sustainable technological development by fostering collaboration between academia, industry, and research institutions. ICCE 2026 encourages original research contributions, practical implementations, case studies, industry innovations, and interdisciplinary research that demonstrate convergence across engineering domains.
